name: any-llm

finish.primary: choices[0].finish_reason; error.completion.choices[0].finish_reason on finish-reason errors. Responses status / incomplete_details.reason; completed with function_call output means tool_calls; refusal parts mean refusal. No separate raw finish. Native Ollama: non-stream tool calls report tool_calls; streams map done_reason directly, including stop on a tool finish; unknown reasons become stop.

text.primary: choices[0].message.content; streaming choices[0].delta.content; error.completion.choices[0].message.content; Responses output message output_text parts or response.output_text.delta

tool_calls.primary: choices[0].message.tool_calls; streaming choices[0].delta.tool_calls joined by index; error.completion.choices[0].message.tool_calls; Responses function_call items use call_id, name and arguments; streaming output_item.added and argument deltas joined by output_index; arguments read with json.loads. Native Ollama generates UUID ids and serializes argument objects; streaming calls have increasing indexes.

usage.primary: usage.prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens; also error.completion.usage on finish-reason errors; Responses usage.input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, input_tokens_details.cached_tokens, output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens. Native Ollama exposes prompt/eval counts and their sum, but no cached or reasoning counts.

structured.primary: response_format is a Pydantic model built from the input schema; choices[0].message.parsed is the parsed output; Responses output_parsed from response_format is reported only on return

stream.primary: Chat: no completion signal (the ChatCompletionChunk iterator ends the same way with or without [DONE]); last finish reason and last usage-bearing chunk. Responses: the final event (response.completed, response.incomplete or response.failed) and no error. Native Ollama also yields ChatCompletionChunk objects without a separate completion signal.

config_notes: any-llm Responses rejects a typed response_format with stream=True; structured scenarios use the non-stream path.
Ollama tool_choice is not mapped; scenarios omit it. Native stream_options is accepted and discarded by any-llm; final usage needs no opt-in.
Native reasoning_effort none becomes think=false; other explicit efforts become low/medium/high strings. The shim passes the requested effort unchanged.
The openai provider remaps max_tokens to max_completion_tokens even with an Ollama base URL. The shim retains this library behavior.
Native Ollama needs the ollama Python package (any-llm-sdk[ollama] extra), pinned here as ollama 0.6.3.
